engineFacts.damageTypeSplit: Every pellet share is split by damage-type weights before mitigation.
engineFacts.pelletMitigation: Defense and resistance are applied independently to every pellet/type share.
engineFacts.concentratedPelletImpact: One hit and one limb selection, followed by all pellet shares on that limb.
engineFacts.effectiveMitigationPacketCount: pellets × non-zero damage types; fire contributes two independently mitigated temporal shares.

draftRules.pelletPolicy: Only low-penetration breakers receive a new pellet architecture. Established saws/fists retain their identity, excessive 3x2 packet combinations are reduced to 2x2, and fire already counts as two temporal packets.
draftRules.platformDeviation: Class ceiling × 0.94..1.06 from the established platform percentile, rounded to 5.
draftRules.damageGrowthLimit: Breakers are capped at 2× current raw damage, hybrids at 1.5×, and penetrators receive no raw-damage increase.
draftRules.penetrationPolicy: Penetration is not numerically changed, but its ratio to same-class heavy armor selects breaker, hybrid, or penetrator architecture.
